title: Paper theorem-type definition surface

traversal_policy.roots: Every top-level theorem declared in namespace KFOL.Paper in Paper.lean; traverse its type, never its proof body.
traversal_policy.project_expansion: Recursively traverse declaration types, non-proof definition/opaque bodies, and reachable inductive constructor types in modules KFOL.* or Paper.
traversal_policy.proof_erasure: Lean.Meta.isProof erases proof-valued subterms with local binders in scope, including proof-only helper definitions. Proposition expressions themselves remain: predicates and hypotheses contribute their mathematical definitions.
traversal_policy.inductives: Reachable inductive declarations include their constructors and mutual inductive declarations. Kernel-generated recursors are indexed by their types; their computation rules are supplied by Lean's inductive kernel.
traversal_policy.external_boundary: Record directly referenced external constants and their declared types without unfolding their definitions or traversing the external dependency closure.
traversal_policy.purpose: A reproducible index for reviewing the mathematical meaning of public statements. It does not establish that a definition matches the manuscript, replace human review, or replace the independent source/import/axiom audits.

review_order: Read each public theorem's literal type in Paper.lean and its per-theorem slice below.

Review central KFOL/Definitions files, then the extra semantic definitions reached in algorithm/round/machine files. Source fingerprints and exact declaration edges identify that complete project surface.
Review the imported GameTheory and ComplexityLib/Cslib boundary types separately. External boundary entries are interfaces, not a claim that their full definition closure was audited here.
Use the existing whole-project axiom/import audit for proof dependencies; they are deliberately absent from this report.

∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) {Var : Type v} [Finite Var] [Nonempty Var]
  (f : (Var → Role) → Role),
  (∃ t,
      (∀ (x : Var → Role),
          ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
        ∀ (x : Var → Role),
          KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (f x)) ↔
    (∃ i g, ∀ (x : Var → Role), f x = g (x i)) ∨ ∃ a b, ∀ (x : Var → Role), f x = a ∨ f x = b

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var) (valuation : Fin 3 → Var → Role),
  (∀ (x : Var), valuation 0 x = valuation 1 x ∨ valuation 0 x = valuation 2 x ∨ valuation 1 x = valuation 2 x) →
    ∀ (out : Fin 3 → Role),
      (∀ (i : Fin 3),
          KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (valuation i x)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (out i)) →
        out 0 = out 1 ∨ out 0 = out 2 ∨ out 1 = out 2

∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin 2)),
  (∀ (x : Fin 2 → Role), ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
    (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
      (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = v 0) ∨
        (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = v 1) ∨
          (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = (v 0).reset (v 1)) ∨
            ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = (v 1).reset (v 0)

∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (f : (Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  (∃ t,
      t.IsCore ∧
        (∀ (x : Fin 2 → Role),
            ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
          (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
            ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = f v) ↔
    (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 0) ∨
      (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 1) ∨
        (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 0).reset (v 1)) ∨
          ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 1).reset (v 0)

Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Words.BinaryNatCode.value Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits

Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Words.unpair? Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
    (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encOption (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encPair Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits)) ∧
  Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Words.undelimitBlocks Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits

          Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits ∧
        (∀ (word left right : List Bool),
            KFOL.Words.unpair? word = some (left, right) ↔ word = KFOL.Words.pair left right) ∧
          ∀ (word : List Bool) (blocks : List (List Bool)),

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role)
  (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  ((∃ c, KFOL.Term.extractCore? 1 t = some c) ↔ ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
    ∀ (c : KFOL.Term Role Var),

∀ {Role : Type v} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (owner : Role),
  Set.ncard KFOL.Dissemilattice.theory = 7 ∧
    Set.Finite KFOL.Dissemilattice.theory ∧
      KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) KFOL.Dissemilattice.theory ∧
        ∀ (M : Type u) [_str : (KFOL.Equational.language KFOL.Dissemilattice.Symbol).Structure M],
          KFOL.Equational.InVariety KFOL.Dissemilattice.Symbol (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) M ↔
            Nonempty M ∧
              (∀ (x : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x x = x) ∧
                (∀ (x y : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x y = KFOL.Dissemilattice.add y x) ∧
                  (∀ (x y z : M),
                      KFOL.Dissemilattice.add (KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x y) z =
                        KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x (KFOL.Dissemilattice.add y z)) ∧
                    (∀ (x : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x x = x) ∧
                      (∀ (x y : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x y = KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul y x) ∧
                        (∀ (x y z : M),
                            KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x y) z =
                              KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul y z)) ∧
                          ∀ (x y z : M),
                            KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x (KFOL.Dissemilattice.add y z) =
                              KFOL.Dissemilattice.add (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x y) (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x z)

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} {Index : Type w} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var)
  (valuation : Index → Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (regions : Index → Set Role),
  (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (regions i) (regions j)) →
    (∀ (i : Index), ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (valuation i) t) ⊆ regions i) →
      ∃ leaf p,
        (leaf, p) ∈ t.sourceOccurrences ∧
          (∀ (i : Index),
              ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.rename p (Sum.elim KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (valuation i) leaf)) ⊆ regions i) ∧
            ((∃ i j, i ≠ j) → ∃ x, leaf = Sum.inr x ∧ (x, p) ∈ t.inputOccurrences)

∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] [inst : Nonempty Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.Congruence Role),
      ∃! c,
        (∀ (owner : Role),
            c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner ∨
              c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.full) ∧
          ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), θ.toSetoid A B ↔ c A = c B) ∧
    (∀ (c : ClosureOperator (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),
        (∀ (owner : Role),
            c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner ∨
              c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.full) →
          ∃ θ, ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), θ.toSetoid A B ↔ c A = c B) ∧
      (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.Congruence Role),
          ∃! F,
            KFOL.WinnerSet.AdmissibleFamily F ∧
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F A = KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F B) ∧
        ∀ (F : Set (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),
          KFOL.WinnerSet.AdmissibleFamily F →
            ∃ θ,
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F A = KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F B

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role),
      KFOL.Rounds.Game.UsesOnly a b game →
        ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
          ∃ x,
            ∃ (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1),
              game.sequentialValues order = {GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix x h0 h1 (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure b)}

∀ {K : ℕ} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Fin K) (canonicalize : { term // term.IsCore } → List Bool),
  Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime canonicalize (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalCoreTermEncoding K)
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits →
    ∀ (compare : List Bool × List Bool → Bool),
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime compare
          (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encPair Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits)
          Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBool →
        (∀ (left right : { term // term.IsCore }),
            compare (canonicalize left, canonicalize right) = true ↔
              ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
                KFOL.Term.eval valuation ↑left = KFOL.Term.eval valuation ↑right) →
          Cslib.Complexity.P Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits = Cslib.Complexity.NP Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (d : ℕ),
      ∃ B _str,
        Nonempty B ∧
          Finite B ∧
            ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.Core.Native Role) B ∧
              ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) B ∧
                (∃ e, e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ∧ ¬e.Holds B) ∧
                  (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                      e.variableCount ≤ d → e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → e.Holds B) ∧
                    ∀ (X : Finset B),
                      X.card ≤ d →
                        Nonempty
                            ↥((FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure
                                    (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role))).toFun
                                ↑X) →
                          KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)
                            ↥((FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure
                                    (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role))).toFun
                                ↑X)) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        (∀ e ∈ T, e.variableCount ≤ d) →
          ¬∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
              e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ KFOL.Equational.Derives T e.lhs e.rhs) ∧
      ∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        Set.Finite T →
          ¬∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
              e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ KFOL.Equational.Derives T e.lhs e.rhs

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] {C : Type v}
  [inst_1 : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Structure C] {P : Type w}
  [inst_2 : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Structure P] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role)
  (hC : KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) C) (e : C),
  (∀ (r : Role) (c : C), KFOL.Core.join three (KFOL.Core.operation r e c) e = e → KFOL.Core.join three c e = e) →
    ∀ (R : Set Role),
      R ≠ Set.univ →
        ∀
          (η :
            (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom ↥(KFOL.Core.ideal hC three e)
              ↥(KFOL.Core.Native.atomicRestriction R)),
          (∀ (c : ↥(KFOL.Core.ideal hC three e)) (r : Role),
              ↑(η c) = KFOL.Core.Native.atom r ↔ KFOL.Core.operation r e ↑c ≠ e) →
            KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) P →
              ∀ (q : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom P C),
                Function.Surjective ⇑q →
                  ∀
                    (label :
                      (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom P
                        ↥(KFOL.Core.Native.atomicRestriction R)),
                    (∀ (u : P) (hu : KFOL.Core.join three (q u) e = e), label u = η ⟨q u, hu⟩) →
                      KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (Option C)

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  Fintype.card (KFOL.Core.Native Role) = Fintype.card Role + 2 ∧
    (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        e.variableCount ≤ Fintype.card Role → e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → e.Holds (KFOL.Core.Native Role)) ∧
      (KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity three).Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ∧
        ¬(KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity three).Holds (KFOL.Core.Native Role) ∧
          (KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity three).variableCount = Fintype.card Role + 1 ∧
            ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (KFOL.Core.Native Role) ∧
              (∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                  (∀ e ∈ T, e.variableCount ≤ Fintype.card Role) → ¬KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) T) ∧
                ∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                  KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) T → ∃ e ∈ T, Fintype.card Role + 1 ≤ e.variableCount

∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) {Var : Type v} [Finite Var] (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  (∀ (x : Var → Role), ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
    (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
      ∃ i,
        ∀ (x : Var → Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun j => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x j)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)

∀ {Role : Type u} {Index : Type v} [inst : Fintype Index] [inst_1 : Nonempty Index] (owner : Role)
  (branches : Index → KFOL.Strategic.Tree Role),
  (∀ (player : Role),
      (∃ plan,
          KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.IsSubgamePerfect owner plan ∧ KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.winner plan = player) ↔
        player ∈ ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold owner Finset.univ ⋯ fun i => KFOL.Strategic.value (branches i))) ∧
    ∃ binary,
      ∀ (player : Role),
        (∃ plan, KFOL.Strategic.IsSubgamePerfect plan ∧ KFOL.Strategic.winner plan = player) ↔
          ∃ plan,
            KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.IsSubgamePerfect owner plan ∧ KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.winner plan = player

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} {Index : Type w} (r : Role) (S : Finset Index) (hS : S.Nonempty)
  (terms : Index → KFOL.Term Role Var),
  (∃ t,
      ∀ (v : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.Term.eval v t = KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold r S hS fun i => KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i)) ∧
    (∀ (v : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        (KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold r S hS fun i => KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i)) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r ↔
          ∃ i ∈ S, KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
      ∀ (v : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        (∀ i ∈ S, KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i) ≠ KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
          ∀ (a : Role),
            a ∈ ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold r S hS fun i => KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i)) ↔
              ∃ i ∈ S, a ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i))

∀ (K : ℕ),
  3 ≤ K →
    Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalEquationEncoding K)
        {equation |
          ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
            KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.2} ∧
      Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalEquationEncoding K)
          {equation |
            equation.1.IsPublic ∧
              equation.2.IsPublic ∧
                ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
                  KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.2} ∧
        Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalEquationEncoding K)
          {equation |
            equation.1.IsCore ∧
              equation.2.IsCore ∧
                ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
                  KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.2}

∀ {Role : Type u} (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        c ∉
            ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice a ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b))
                (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a) (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton c)) ∧
          c ∈
            ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice a ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b))
                (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b) (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton c))

∀ {Role : Type} [Fintype Role] (a b d : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ d →
      b ≠ d →
        Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete KFOL.Complexity.GuardedPairMachines.equationEncoding
            {equation |
              ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation =
                  KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation} ∧
          Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
              {word |
                ∃ equation,
                  KFOL.FiniteTermCode.encodeEquation KFOL.GuardedPair.Symbol equation = word ∧
                    ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                      KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation =
                        KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation} ∧
            Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete KFOL.Complexity.GuardedPairMachines.equationEncoding
                {equation |
                  ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                    d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation) ↔
                      d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation)} ∧
              Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
                {word |
                  ∃ equation,
                    KFOL.FiniteTermCode.encodeEquation KFOL.GuardedPair.Symbol equation = word ∧
                      ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                        d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation) ↔
                          d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation)}

∀ {Role : Type u} (a b d : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ d →
      b ≠ d →
        ∀ (formula : KFOL.Reductions.CNF),
          ((∀ (x : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b (KFOL.Reductions.GuardedPair.equation formula).1 x =
                  KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b (KFOL.Reductions.GuardedPair.equation formula).2 x) ↔
              ¬KFOL.Reductions.Satisfiable formula) ∧
            ((∀ (x : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                  d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b (KFOL.Reductions.GuardedPair.equation formula).1 x) ↔
                    d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b (KFOL.Reductions.GuardedPair.equation formula).2 x)) ↔
                ¬KFOL.Reductions.Satisfiable formula) ∧
              (KFOL.Reductions.GuardedPair.equation formula).1.size +

∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
      (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
        t.vars.Nonempty ∧
          ∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            (∀ (x : Fin n), (valuation x).Ambiguous) →
              ∀ (r : Role), r ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) ↔ ∃ x ∈ t.vars, r ∈ ↑(valuation x)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (s t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
        (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) s = A) →
          (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
            ((∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                (∀ (x : Fin n), (valuation x).Ambiguous) → KFOL.Term.eval valuation s = KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) ↔
              s.vars = t.vars)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)),
          S.Nonempty → ∃ t, t.IsCore ∧ t.vars = S ∧ ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n),
            (KFOL.Term.var i).vars = {i} ∧
              ∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval valuation (KFOL.Term.var i) = valuation i) ∧
          (∀ (m n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin m)) (replacement : Fin m → KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
              (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
                (∀ (x : Fin m) (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) (replacement x) = A) →
                  (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) (KFOL.Term.subst replacement t) = A) ∧
                    ((KFOL.Term.subst replacement t).vars = t.vars.biUnion fun x => (replacement x).vars) ∧
                      ∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                        KFOL.Term.eval valuation (KFOL.Term.subst replacement t) =
                          KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => KFOL.Term.eval valuation (replacement x)) t) ∧
            (∀ (n : ℕ),
                0 < n →
                  ∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
                    ¬∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (i : Fin n),
                        KFOL.Term.eval (Function.update (fun x => A) i B) t = A) ∧
              (∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin 3)),
                  ¬((∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => if i = 0 then A else B) t = A) ∧
                      ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => if i = 2 then B else A) t = B)) ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
                    t.IsCore →
                      ∀ x ∈ t.vars,
                        ∃ v w, (∀ (y : Fin n), y ≠ x → v y = w y) ∧ KFOL.Term.eval v t ≠ KFOL.Term.eval w t) ∧
                  ∀ (n : ℕ) (s t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
                    s.IsCore →
                      t.IsCore →
                        (∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                            KFOL.Term.eval valuation s = KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) →
                          s.vars = t.vars

∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) {Var : Type v} [Finite Var] [Nonempty Var]
  (f : (Var → Role) → Role),
  (∃ t,
      (∀ (x : Var → Role),
          ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
        ∀ (x : Var → Role),
          KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (f x)) ↔
    (∃ i g, ∀ (x : Var → Role), f x = g (x i)) ∨ ∃ a b, ∀ (x : Var → Role), f x = a ∨ f x = b

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.atomic_repeated_triples

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.binary_atom_preserving
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin 2)),
  (∀ (x : Fin 2 → Role), ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
    (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
      (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = v 0) ∨
        (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = v 1) ∨
          (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = (v 0).reset (v 1)) ∨
            ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = (v 1).reset (v 0)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.binary_atom_preserving_iff
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (f : (Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  (∃ t,
      t.IsCore ∧
        (∀ (x : Fin 2 → Role),
            ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
          (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
            ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = f v) ↔
    (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 0) ∨
      (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 1) ∨
        (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 0).reset (v 1)) ∨
          ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 1).reset (v 0)

project_declarations.type:

  Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Words.undelimitBlocks Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.checked_core_extraction
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role)
  (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  ((∃ c, KFOL.Term.extractCore? 1 t = some c) ↔ ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
    ∀ (c : KFOL.Term Role Var),
      KFOL.Term.extractCore? 1 t = some c →
        c.IsCore ∧
          (∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval valuation c = KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) ∧
            c.size ≤ t.size

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.choice_union_basis
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type v} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (owner : Role),
  Set.ncard KFOL.Dissemilattice.theory = 7 ∧
    Set.Finite KFOL.Dissemilattice.theory ∧
      KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) KFOL.Dissemilattice.theory ∧
        ∀ (M : Type u) [_str : (KFOL.Equational.language KFOL.Dissemilattice.Symbol).Structure M],
          KFOL.Equational.InVariety KFOL.Dissemilattice.Symbol (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) M ↔
            Nonempty M ∧
              (∀ (x : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x x = x) ∧
                (∀ (x y : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x y = KFOL.Dissemilattice.add y x) ∧
                  (∀ (x y z : M),
                      KFOL.Dissemilattice.add (KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x y) z =
                        KFOL.Dissemilattice.add x (KFOL.Dissemilattice.add y z)) ∧
                    (∀ (x : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x x = x) ∧
                      (∀ (x y : M), KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x y = KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul y x) ∧
                        (∀ (x y z : M),
                            KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x y) z =
                              KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul y z)) ∧
                          ∀ (x y z : M),
                            KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x (KFOL.Dissemilattice.add y z) =
                              KFOL.Dissemilattice.add (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x y) (KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul x z)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.common_source
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} {Index : Type w} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var)
  (valuation : Index → Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (regions : Index → Set Role),
  (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (regions i) (regions j)) →
    (∀ (i : Index), ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (valuation i) t) ⊆ regions i) →
      ∃ leaf p,
        (leaf, p) ∈ t.sourceOccurrences ∧
          (∀ (i : Index),
              ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.rename p (Sum.elim KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (valuation i) leaf)) ⊆ regions i) ∧
            ((∃ i j, i ≠ j) → ∃ x, leaf = Sum.inr x ∧ (x, p) ∈ t.inputOccurrences)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.congruence_classification
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] [inst : Nonempty Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.Congruence Role),
      ∃! c,
        (∀ (owner : Role),
            c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner ∨
              c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.full) ∧
          ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), θ.toSetoid A B ↔ c A = c B) ∧
    (∀ (c : ClosureOperator (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),
        (∀ (owner : Role),
            c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner ∨
              c (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner) = KFOL.WinnerSet.full) →
          ∃ θ, ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), θ.toSetoid A B ↔ c A = c B) ∧
      (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.Congruence Role),
          ∃! F,
            KFOL.WinnerSet.AdmissibleFamily F ∧
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F A = KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F B) ∧
        ∀ (F : Set (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),
          KFOL.WinnerSet.AdmissibleFamily F →
            ∃ θ,
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F A = KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.constant_sum_round_values
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role),
      KFOL.Rounds.Game.UsesOnly a b game →
        ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
          ∃ x,
            ∃ (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1),
              game.sequentialValues order = {GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix x h0 h1 (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure b)}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.core_canonicalization_collapse
project_declarations.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Fin K) (canonicalize : { term // term.IsCore } → List Bool),
  Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime canonicalize (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalCoreTermEncoding K)
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits →
    ∀ (compare : List Bool × List Bool → Bool),
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime compare
          (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encPair Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits)
          Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBool →
        (∀ (left right : { term // term.IsCore }),
            compare (canonicalize left, canonicalize right) = true ↔
              ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
                KFOL.Term.eval valuation ↑left = KFOL.Term.eval valuation ↑right) →
          Cslib.Complexity.P Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits = Cslib.Complexity.NP Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.core_nonfinite_basis
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (d : ℕ),
      ∃ B _str,
        Nonempty B ∧
          Finite B ∧
            ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.Core.Native Role) B ∧
              ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) B ∧
                (∃ e, e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ∧ ¬e.Holds B) ∧
                  (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                      e.variableCount ≤ d → e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → e.Holds B) ∧
                    ∀ (X : Finset B),
                      X.card ≤ d →
                        Nonempty
                            ↥((FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure
                                    (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role))).toFun
                                ↑X) →
                          KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)
                            ↥((FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.closure
                                    (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role))).toFun
                                ↑X)) ∧
    (∀ (d : ℕ) (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        (∀ e ∈ T, e.variableCount ≤ d) →
          ¬∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
              e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ KFOL.Equational.Derives T e.lhs e.rhs) ∧
      ∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        Set.Finite T →
          ¬∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
              e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ KFOL.Equational.Derives T e.lhs e.rhs

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.core_typed_upper_clone_cover
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] {C : Type v}
  [inst_1 : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Structure C] {P : Type w}
  [inst_2 : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Structure P] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role)
  (hC : KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) C) (e : C),
  (∀ (r : Role) (c : C), KFOL.Core.join three (KFOL.Core.operation r e c) e = e → KFOL.Core.join three c e = e) →
    ∀ (R : Set Role),
      R ≠ Set.univ →
        ∀
          (η :
            (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom ↥(KFOL.Core.ideal hC three e)
              ↥(KFOL.Core.Native.atomicRestriction R)),
          (∀ (c : ↥(KFOL.Core.ideal hC three e)) (r : Role),
              ↑(η c) = KFOL.Core.Native.atom r ↔ KFOL.Core.operation r e ↑c ≠ e) →
            KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) P →
              ∀ (q : (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom P C),
                Function.Surjective ⇑q →
                  ∀
                    (label :
                      (KFOL.Equational.language (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)).Hom P
                        ↥(KFOL.Core.Native.atomicRestriction R)),
                    (∀ (u : P) (hu : KFOL.Core.join three (q u) e = e), label u = η ⟨q u, hu⟩) →
                      KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (Option C)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.core_variable_bound_obstruction
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  Fintype.card (KFOL.Core.Native Role) = Fintype.card Role + 2 ∧
    (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
        e.variableCount ≤ Fintype.card Role → e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → e.Holds (KFOL.Core.Native Role)) ∧
      (KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity three).Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ∧
        ¬(KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity three).Holds (KFOL.Core.Native Role) ∧
          (KFOL.Core.exhaustionIdentity three).variableCount = Fintype.card Role + 1 ∧
            ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (KFOL.Core.Native Role) ∧
              (∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                  (∀ e ∈ T, e.variableCount ≤ Fintype.card Role) → ¬KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) T) ∧
                ∀ (T : KFOL.Equational.Theory (KFOL.Equational.CoreSymbol Role)),
                  KFOL.Equational.IsBasis (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) T → ∃ e ∈ T, Fintype.card Role + 1 ≤ e.variableCount

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.determinacy
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) {Var : Type v} [Finite Var] (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  (∀ (x : Var → Role), ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
    (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
      ∃ i,
        ∀ (x : Var → Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun j => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x j)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.finite_action_quantifier
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Index : Type v} [inst : Fintype Index] [inst_1 : Nonempty Index] (owner : Role)
  (branches : Index → KFOL.Strategic.Tree Role),
  (∀ (player : Role),
      (∃ plan,
          KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.IsSubgamePerfect owner plan ∧ KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.winner plan = player) ↔
        player ∈ ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold owner Finset.univ ⋯ fun i => KFOL.Strategic.value (branches i))) ∧
    ∃ binary,
      ∀ (player : Role),
        (∃ plan, KFOL.Strategic.IsSubgamePerfect plan ∧ KFOL.Strategic.winner plan = player) ↔
          ∃ plan,
            KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.IsSubgamePerfect owner plan ∧ KFOL.Strategic.FiniteChoice.winner plan = player

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.finite_public_choices
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} {Index : Type w} (r : Role) (S : Finset Index) (hS : S.Nonempty)
  (terms : Index → KFOL.Term Role Var),
  (∃ t,
      ∀ (v : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.Term.eval v t = KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold r S hS fun i => KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i)) ∧
    (∀ (v : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        (KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold r S hS fun i => KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i)) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r ↔
          ∃ i ∈ S, KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i) = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
      ∀ (v : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        (∀ i ∈ S, KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i) ≠ KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
          ∀ (a : Role),
            a ∈ ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold r S hS fun i => KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i)) ↔
              ∃ i ∈ S, a ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval v (terms i))

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.fixed_equational_complexity
project_declarations.type:
∀ (K : ℕ),
  3 ≤ K →
    Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalEquationEncoding K)
        {equation |
          ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
            KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.2} ∧
      Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalEquationEncoding K)
          {equation |
            equation.1.IsPublic ∧
              equation.2.IsPublic ∧
                ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
                  KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.2} ∧
        Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete (KFOL.Complexity.FullHardness.originalEquationEncoding K)
          {equation |
            equation.1.IsCore ∧
              equation.2.IsCore ∧
                ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin K)),
                  KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation equation.2}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.guarded_choice_example
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        c ∉
            ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice a ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b))
                (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a) (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton c)) ∧
          c ∈
            ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice a ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b))
                (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b) (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton c))

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.guarded_pair_complexity
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type} [Fintype Role] (a b d : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ d →
      b ≠ d →
        Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete KFOL.Complexity.GuardedPairMachines.equationEncoding
            {equation |
              ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation =
                  KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation} ∧
          Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
              {word |
                ∃ equation,
                  KFOL.FiniteTermCode.encodeEquation KFOL.GuardedPair.Symbol equation = word ∧
                    ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                      KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation =
                        KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation} ∧
            Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete KFOL.Complexity.GuardedPairMachines.equationEncoding
                {equation |
                  ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                    d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation) ↔
                      d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation)} ∧
              Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
                {word |
                  ∃ equation,
                    KFOL.FiniteTermCode.encodeEquation KFOL.GuardedPair.Symbol equation = word ∧
                      ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                        d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.1 valuation) ↔
                          d ∈ ↑(KFOL.GuardedPair.Term.eval a b equation.2 valuation)}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.guarded_pair_reduction
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (a b d : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ d →
      b ≠ d →

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [DecidableEq Role] {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (T : KFOL.Owner.GuardTable Var)
  (owner observer background : Role),
  observer ≠ owner →
    observer ≠ background →
      owner ≠ background →
        ∀ (positions : List Var),
          T.Canonical →
            T.Listed positions →
              (T.check positions = true ↔
                  ∃ t,
                    t.root = T.root ∧
                      KFOL.Owner.Term.OwnersIn (fun a => a = owner) t ∧
                        ∀ (k : Role),
                          k ≠ owner →
                            ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                              k ∈ ↑(t.eval valuation) ↔
                                T.Enabled {i | (valuation i).Ambiguous}
                                  {i | valuation i ≠ KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner} {i | k ∈ ↑(valuation i)}) ∧
                ((T.synthesize owner positions).isSome = true ↔ T.check positions = true) ∧
                  (∀ (t : KFOL.Owner.Term Role Var),
                      T.synthesize owner positions = some t →
                        t.root = T.root ∧
                          KFOL.Owner.Term.OwnersIn (fun a => a = owner) t ∧
                            (∀ (k : Role),
                                k ≠ owner →
                                  ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                                    k ∈ ↑(t.eval valuation) ↔
                                      T.Enabled {i | (valuation i).Ambiguous}
                                        {i | valuation i ≠ KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton owner} {i | k ∈ ↑(valuation i)}) ∧
                              t.size ≤ 1 + T.entries.length * (10 * positions.length + 7)) ∧
                    ∀ (left right : List Var) (j : Var) (g : KFOL.Owner.GuardPair Var),
                      T.root ∈ g.many →
                        KFOL.Owner.GuardTable.target j g ⊆ left.toFinset →
                          KFOL.Owner.GuardTable.target j g ⊆ right.toFinset →
                            (T.run left j g (2 * left.length)).1 = (T.run right j g (2 * right.length)).1

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.player_view_orders
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (k r : Role),
  (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
      KFOL.WinnerSet.view k (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice r A B) =
        KFOL.PlayerView.choice r (KFOL.WinnerSet.view k A) (KFOL.WinnerSet.view k B)) ∧
    ∃ order,
      have x := order;
      (∀ (p q : KFOL.PlayerView k), p ⊔ q = KFOL.PlayerView.choice r p q) ∧
        ∀ (p q : KFOL.PlayerView k),
          p ≤ q ↔
            match p, q with
            | KFOL.PlayerView.possible, KFOL.PlayerView.possible => True
            | KFOL.PlayerView.possible, KFOL.PlayerView.impossible => False
            | KFOL.PlayerView.possible, KFOL.PlayerView.other j => ↑j = r
            | KFOL.PlayerView.impossible, KFOL.PlayerView.possible => True
            | KFOL.PlayerView.impossible, KFOL.PlayerView.impossible => True
            | KFOL.PlayerView.impossible, KFOL.PlayerView.other j => ↑j = r
            | KFOL.PlayerView.other i, KFOL.PlayerView.possible => ↑i ≠ r
            | KFOL.PlayerView.other i, KFOL.PlayerView.impossible => ↑i ≠ r
            | KFOL.PlayerView.other i, KFOL.PlayerView.other j => i = j ∨ ↑j = r

                    ((i : { r // r ≠ k }) → motive (KFOL.PlayerView.other i) KFOL.PlayerView.possible) →

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.policy_family_checker
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Label : Type v} {Var : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Label]
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq Var] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (D : Label → Finset Role) (roles : List Role) (labels : List Label),
  (∀ (r : Role), r ∈ roles) →
    (∀ (d : Label), d ∈ labels) →
      ((∀ (r s : Role),
            KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) r ⊆ KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) s ∨
              KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) s ⊆ KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) r) ∨
          (∀ (r s : Role),
              ∃ t,
                KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) t =
                  KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) r ∩ KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) s) ∧
            ∃ r s,
              r ≠ s ∧
                KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) r = KFOL.Policies.passingPattern (fun d => ↑(D d)) s) →
        ∀ (left right : KFOL.Policies.Term Label Var),
          KFOL.Policies.Term.familyEquationB D roles labels left right = true ↔
            ∀ (x : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
              KFOL.Policies.Term.eval (fun d => ↑(D d)) left x = KFOL.Policies.Term.eval (fun d => ↑(D d)) right x

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.policy_family_dichotomy
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role Label : Type} [Fintype Role] [inst : Fintype Label] [DecidableEq Role] [DecidableEq Label]
  (D : Label → Finset Role) (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  have pattern := fun r => {d | r ∉ D d};
  have easy :=
    (∀ (r s : Role), pattern r ⊆ pattern s ∨ pattern s ⊆ pattern r) ∨
      (∀ (r s : Role), ∃ t, pattern t = pattern r ∩ pattern s) ∧ ∃ r s, r ≠ s ∧ pattern r = pattern s;
  have language :=
    {word |
      ∃ equation,
        KFOL.FiniteTermCode.encodeEquation (KFOL.Policies.Symbol Label) equation = word ∧
          ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            KFOL.Policies.Term.eval (fun d => ↑(D d)) equation.1 valuation =
              KFOL.Policies.Term.eval (fun d => ↑(D d)) equation.2 valuation};
  (easy → language ∈ Cslib.Complexity.P Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits) ∧
    (¬easy → Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits language)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.public_nonconvexity
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
          (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a
                    (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice c (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf a) (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf b))
                    (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf c)).sequentialValues
                order =
              {value |
                  ∃ α,
                    ∃ (h0 : 0 ≤ α) (h1 : α ≤ 1),
                      value = GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix α h0 h1 (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure b)} ∪
                {value |
                  ∃ α,
                    ∃ (h0 : 0 ≤ α) (h1 : α ≤ 1),
                      value = GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix α h0 h1 (PMF.pure b) (PMF.pure c)} ∧
            have midpoint :=
              GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix (1 / 2) KFOL.Paper.public_nonconvexity._proof_1
                KFOL.Paper.public_nonconvexity._proof_2 (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure c);
            midpoint ∉
                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a
                      (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice c (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf a) (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf b))
                      (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf c)).sequentialValues
                  order ∧
              midpoint ∈
                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice b
                      (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a
                        (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice c (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf a) (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf b))
                        (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf c))
                      (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice a
                        (KFOL.Rounds.Game.publicChoice c (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf a) (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf b))
                        (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf c))).sequentialValues
                  order

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (formula : KFOL.Reductions.CNF),
          ((∀ (v : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                KFOL.RawPair.Term.eval (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice a) KFOL.WinnerSet.union
                    (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.equation formula).1 v =
                  KFOL.RawPair.Term.eval (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice a) KFOL.WinnerSet.union
                    (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.equation formula).2 v) ↔
              ¬KFOL.Reductions.Satisfiable formula) ∧
            ((∀ (v : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                  KFOL.RawPair.Term.eval (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice a) (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice b)
                      (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.twoOwnerEquation formula).1 v =
                    KFOL.RawPair.Term.eval (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice a) (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice b)
                      (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.twoOwnerEquation formula).2 v) ↔
                ¬KFOL.Reductions.Satisfiable formula) ∧
              ((∀ (v : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                    KFOL.RawPair.Term.eval KFOL.WinnerSet.reset (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice a)
                        (KFOL.Reductions.ResetChoice.equation formula).1 v =
                      KFOL.RawPair.Term.eval KFOL.WinnerSet.reset (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice a)
                        (KFOL.Reductions.ResetChoice.equation formula).2 v) ↔
                  ¬KFOL.Reductions.Satisfiable formula) ∧
                (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.equation formula).1.size + (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.equation formula).2.size ≤
                    4 + 20 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length +
                      2 * (List.map List.length formula).sum ∧
                  (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.twoOwnerEquation formula).1.size +
                        (KFOL.Reductions.RawPair.twoOwnerEquation formula).2.size ≤
                      4 + 20 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length +
                        2 * (List.map List.length formula).sum ∧
                    (KFOL.Reductions.ResetChoice.equation formula).1.size +
                        (KFOL.Reductions.ResetChoice.equation formula).2.size ≤
                      28 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length + 2 * List.length formula +
                          2 * (List.flatten formula).length +
                        8

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.raw_signature_dichotomy
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type} [Fintype Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (selected : Finset (KFOL.Raw.Operation Role)),

        KFOL.FiniteTermCode.encodeEquation (KFOL.Raw.Symbol selected) equation = word ∧
          ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), equation.1.eval valuation = equation.2.eval valuation};

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reciprocal_round_values

project_declarations.type:

  (∀ (n : ℕ) (s t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
      s.IsPublic →
        t.IsPublic →

              (∀ (x : Fin n), valuation x ∈ D) → KFOL.Term.eval valuation s = KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) →

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_basis
KFOL.Paper.reset_binary_descriptor_codec
project_declarations.type:
(∀ (word : List Bool) (d : KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor),
    KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.decode word = some d ↔ word = d.encode) ∧
  Function.Injective KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.encode ∧
    (∀ (d : KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor),
        d.labels.Nodup ∧
          d.encode.length =
              4 * (List.map Nat.size d.labels).sum + 4 * d.labels.length + 2 +
                (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList d.records).length ∧
            d.labels.length ≤ d.encode.length ∧
              d.records.length ≤ d.encode.length ∧
                List.mapM (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.compressEntry d.labels)
                      (List.map (fun r => (d.labels.get r.1, KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand d.labels r.2))
                        d.records) =
                    some d.records ∧
                  (∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length) (A : Finset (Fin d.labels.length)),
                      A ∈ d.guards j ↔ (j, A) ∈ d.records) ∧
                    ∀ (r j : Fin d.labels.length) (B : Finset (Fin d.labels.length)),
                      (d.table r).Enabled (↑B) j ↔
                        ∃ A,
                          (j, A) ∈ d.records ∧
                            KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.subsetWord (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode A)
                                (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode B) =
                              [true]) ∧
      ∀ (word output : List Bool),
        KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.extract word = some output →
          ∃ d t,
            KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.decode output = some d ∧
              KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.decode word = some t ∧
                d.labels = KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.labels t ∧
                  List.map (fun r => (d.labels.get r.1, KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand d.labels r.2)) d.records =
                    t.guardEntries

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_binary_equation_checker
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (s t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ),
      (KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.labels s t).Nodup ∧
        (KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.labels s t).toFinset =
            FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset s ∪ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t ∧
          (KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.labels s t).length ≤ s.leafCount + t.leafCount ∧
            (KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.labels s t).length ≤
                (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode s).length + (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t).length ∧
              (KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.check s t = true ↔ s.table = t.table) ∧
                (KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.check s t = true ↔
                  ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation)) ∧
    (∀ (word : List Bool),
        KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.checkWord word = true ↔
          ∃ s t,
            word = KFOL.Words.pair (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode s) (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t) ∧
              ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation) ∧
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime (fun p => KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.check p.1 p.2)
          (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encPair KFOL.Complexity.TermMachine.termEncoding KFOL.Complexity.TermMachine.termEncoding)
          Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBool ∧
        Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Algorithms.ResetEquation.checkWord Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
          Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBool

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_binary_extraction
project_declarations.type:
(∀ (word : List Bool), KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.extract word = none ↔ KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.decode word = none) ∧
  ∀ (word : List Bool) (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ),
    KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.decode word = some t →
      have D := KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.labels t;
      ∃ records,
        KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.extract word =
            some
              (KFOL.Words.pair (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D)
                (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records)) ∧
          records.length = t.leafCount ∧
            List.map (fun r => (D.get r.1, KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand D r.2)) records = t.guardEntries ∧
              KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.decode (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D) = some D ∧
                KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.decodeList D.length (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records) =
                    some records ∧
                  (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D).length ≤ word.length ∧
                    (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records).length ≤ 6 * word.length * (word.length + 1) ∧
                      (KFOL.Words.pair (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D)
                              (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records)).length ≤
                          6 * word.length * (word.length + 1) + 2 * word.length + 2 ∧
                        ∀ (j : ℕ),
                          KFOL.Reset.Term.minimize
                              (List.map Prod.snd
                                  (List.filter (fun p => decide (p.1 = j))
                                    (List.map (fun r => (D.get r.1, KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand D r.2))
                                      records))).toFinset =
                            t.table j

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_binary_guard_records
project_declarations.type:
∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ),
  have D := KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.labels t;
  (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D).length ≤
      2 * (List.map (fun p => p.1.size) t.guardEntries).sum + 2 * t.leafCount ∧
    ∃ records,
      List.mapM (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.compressEntry D) t.guardEntries = some records ∧
        records.length = t.leafCount ∧
          List.map (fun r => (D.get r.1, KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand D r.2)) records = t.guardEntries ∧
            KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.decodeList D.length (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records) =
                some records ∧
              (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records).length ≤ 6 * t.leafCount * (t.leafCount + 1) ∧
                ∀ (j : ℕ),
                  KFOL.Reset.Term.minimize
                      (List.map Prod.snd
                          (List.filter (fun p => decide (p.1 = j))
                            (List.map (fun r => (D.get r.1, KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand D r.2))
                              records))).toFinset =
                    t.table j

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_binary_input_codec
project_declarations.type:
(∀ (word : List Bool) (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ),
    KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.decode word = some t ↔ word = KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t) ∧
  Function.Injective KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode ∧
    (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ) (rest : List Bool),
        KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.decode (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t ++ rest) =
          if rest.isEmpty = true then some t else none) ∧
      (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ),
          (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t).length =
              t.size + 2 * t.leafCount + 2 * (List.map (fun p => p.1.size) t.guardEntries).sum ∧
            t.size ≤ (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t).length ∧
              t.leafCount ≤ (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t).length) ∧
        (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ) (rest : List Bool) (fuel : ℕ),
            t.size ≤ fuel →
              KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.parse fuel (KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t ++ rest) = some (t, rest)) ∧
          ∀ (fuel : ℕ) (word rest : List Bool) (t : KFOL.Reset.Term ℕ),
            KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.parse fuel word = some (t, rest) →
              KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.encode t ++ rest = word ∧ t.size + rest.length ≤ word.length

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_circuit_exponential_tables

    equation.WellFormed ∧
      equation.gates.length = 6 * n + 3 ∧
        KFOL.Circuit.operationCount equation.gates = 4 * n + 1 ∧
          KFOL.Circuit.edgeCount equation.gates = 8 * n + 2 ∧

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_circuit_generator

      ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_circuit_reduction

        7 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length + 2 * (List.flatten formula).length + 3 ∧
      KFOL.Circuit.operationCount (KFOL.Circuit.ResetCNF.equation formula).gates =
          5 * (KFOL.Reductions.ResetUnion.support formula).length + 2 * (List.flatten formula).length + 1 ∧

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_encoded_table_recognition
project_declarations.type:
(∀ (d : KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor),
    d.check = true ↔
      ∃ r,
        (∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length), ∀ A ∈ d.guards j, ∀ B ∈ d.guards j, A ⊆ B → A = B) ∧
          d.guards r = {∅} ∧
            (∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length), ∅ ∈ d.guards j → j = r) ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length), ∀ A ∈ d.guards j, j ∉ A) ∧
                ∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length), ∀ A ∈ d.guards j, (d.table r).Constructible A) ∧
  (∀ (d : KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor),
      d.check = true ↔ ∃ t, t.table = d.guards ∧ t.size ≤ 1 + 2 * d.labels.length * d.records.length) ∧
    (∀ (word : List Bool),
        KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.recognize word = true ↔
          ∃ d t, word = d.encode ∧ t.table = d.guards ∧ t.size ≤ 1 + 2 * word.length * word.length) ∧
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.check
          KFOL.Complexity.DescriptorValidation.descriptorEncoding Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBool ∧
        Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.recognize Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
          Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBool

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (s t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_guard_extraction
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),
  t.collectGuards.1 = t.root ∧
    t.guardEntries.length = t.leafCount ∧
      t.size + 1 = 2 * t.leafCount ∧
        (∀ (j : Var),
            (List.filter (fun p => decide (p.1 = j)) t.guardEntries).length = t.occurrences j ∧
              t.guards j = (List.map Prod.snd (List.filter (fun p => decide (p.1 = j)) t.guardEntries)).toFinset ∧
                t.table j =
                  KFOL.Reset.Term.minimize
                    (List.map Prod.snd (List.filter (fun p => decide (p.1 = j)) t.guardEntries)).toFinset) ∧
          ∀ (j : Var) (A : Finset Var),
            (j, A) ∈ t.guardEntries →
              j ∈ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t ∧
                A ⊆ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t ∧ A.card + 1 ≤ t.leafCount

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_guard_record_codec
project_declarations.type:
(∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin n × Finset (Fin n)) (word : List Bool),
    (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.decode n word = some r ↔ word = KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encode r) ∧
      (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encode r).length = 2 * (↑r.1).size + 2 + n) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (records : List (Fin n × Finset (Fin n))) (word : List Bool),
      (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.decodeList n word = some records ↔
          word = KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records) ∧
        (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardRecord.encodeList records).length ≤ 6 * records.length * (n + 1)) ∧
    ∀ (D : List ℕ) (word : List Bool),
      (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.decode word = some D ↔ word = KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D) ∧
        (KFOL.Algorithms.LabelDictionary.encode D).length = 2 * (List.map Nat.size D).sum + 2 * D.length

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_guard_subset_machine
project_declarations.type:
Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime (fun v => KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.subsetWord (v 0) (v 1))
    (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encPi Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits) Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Finset (Fin n)),
      (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode A).length = n ∧
        ∀ (word : List Bool), KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.decode n word = some A ↔ word = KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode A) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (A B : Finset (Fin n)),
        KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.subsetWord (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode A) (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode B) =
            [true] ↔
          A ⊆ B) ∧
      (∀ (a b : List Bool),
          KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.subsetWord a b = [true] ↔
            a.length = b.length ∧
              ∀ i < a.length,
                KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.readBit a i = true → KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.readBit b i = true) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : KFOL.Reset.GuardTable (Fin n)) (A : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n),
          G.Enabled (↑A) j ↔
            ∃ C ∈ G.guards j,
              KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.subsetWord (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode C)
                  (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode A) =
                [true]

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_minimum_generator
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  Fintype.card (Fin 3) = 3 ∧
    (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity KFOL.Reset.Symbol), e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ e.Holds (Fin 3)) ∧
      ∀ (M : Type v) [inst : Fintype M] [inst_1 : (KFOL.Equational.language KFOL.Reset.Symbol).Structure M],
        (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity KFOL.Reset.Symbol), e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ e.Holds M) →
          3 ≤ Fintype.card M

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_normalized_binary_extraction
project_declarations.type:
∀ (word output : List Bool),
  KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.extract word = some output →
    ∃ d t,
      KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.decode output = some d ∧
        KFOL.Algorithms.TermCode.decode word = some t ∧
          d.labels = KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.labels t ∧
            KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.normalizeWord output = some d.normalize.encode ∧
              KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.recognize d.normalize.encode = true ∧
                ∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length),
                  Finset.image (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand d.labels) (d.normalize.guards j) =
                    t.table (d.labels.get j)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_record_normalization
project_declarations.type:
(∀ (d : KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor),
    d.normalize.labels = d.labels ∧
      d.normalize.records.Sublist d.records ∧
        d.normalize.normalize = d.normalize ∧
          d.normalize.encode.length ≤ d.encode.length ∧
            (∀ (j : Fin d.labels.length), d.normalize.guards j = KFOL.Reset.Term.minimize (d.guards j)) ∧
              ∀ (r j : Fin d.labels.length) (B : Set (Fin d.labels.length)),
                (d.normalize.table r).Enabled B j ↔ (d.table r).Enabled B j) ∧
  (∀ (word : List Bool),
      KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.normalizeWord word = none ↔ KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.decode word = none) ∧
    (∀ (word output : List Bool),
        KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.normalizeWord word = some output →
          ∃ d,
            KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.decode word = some d ∧
              output = d.normalize.encode ∧
                KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.decode output = some d.normalize ∧
                  output.length ≤ word.length ∧ KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.normalizeWord output = some output) ∧
      Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.normalize
          KFOL.Complexity.DescriptorValidation.descriptorEncoding
          KFOL.Complexity.DescriptorValidation.descriptorEncoding ∧
        Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.Algorithms.GuardDescriptor.normalizeWord Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
          (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encOption Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_selection
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v},
  (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var) (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
      (t.eval valuation).Ambiguous ↔ (valuation t.root).Ambiguous) ∧
    (∀ (i j : Var) (B : Set Var), KFOL.Reset.Term.Selected (FirstOrder.Language.var i) B j ↔ j = i) ∧
      (∀ (s t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var) (B : Set Var) (j : Var),
          (s.step t).Selected B j ↔ t.Selected B j ∨ t.root ∈ B ∧ s.Selected B j) ∧
        (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var) (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (r : Role),
            r ∈ ↑(t.eval valuation) ↔ ∃ j, t.Selected {i | (valuation i).Ambiguous} j ∧ r ∈ ↑(valuation j)) ∧
          (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var) (B C : Set Var), B ⊆ C → ∀ (j : Var), t.Selected B j → t.Selected C j) ∧
            (∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var) (B : Set Var), t.Selected B t.root) ∧
              ∀ (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var) (B C : Set Var) (j : Var),
                (∀ (i : Var), i ≠ j → (i ∈ B ↔ i ∈ C)) → (t.Selected B j ↔ t.Selected C j)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_substitution
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Var : Type v} {Var' : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq Var] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Var'] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var)
  (inner : Var → KFOL.Reset.Term Var'),
  KFOL.Reset.Term.root (FirstOrder.Language.Term.subst t inner) = (inner t.root).root ∧
    (∀ {Role : Type u} (valuation : Var' → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.Reset.Term.eval (FirstOrder.Language.Term.subst t inner) valuation =
          t.eval fun i => (inner i).eval valuation) ∧
      ∀ (j : Var'),
        KFOL.Reset.Term.table (FirstOrder.Language.Term.subst t inner) j =
          KFOL.Reset.Term.minimize
            ((FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t).biUnion fun i =>
              (t.table i).biUnion fun A =>
                Finset.image (fun C => Finset.image (fun k => (inner k).root) A ∪ C) ((inner i).table j))

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_support_indexing
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),
  have D := KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.labels t;
  D.Nodup ∧
    D.toFinset = FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t ∧
      D.length = (FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t).card ∧
        D.length ≤ t.leafCount ∧
          (∃ e, ∀ (i : Fin D.length), ↑(e i) = D.get i) ∧
            (∀ (j : Var) (i : Fin D.length), KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.locate D j = some i ↔ D.get i = j) ∧
              (∀ A ⊆ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t,
                  KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand D (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.compress D A) = A) ∧
                (∀ (A : Finset (Fin D.length)),
                    KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.compress D (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.expand D A) = A) ∧
                  ∀ (A B : Finset Var),
                    A ⊆ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t →
                      (KFOL.Algorithms.GuardWords.subsetWord
                            (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.compress D A))
                            (KFOL.Algorithms.Bitset.encode (KFOL.Algorithms.SupportIndex.compress D B)) =
                          [true] ↔
                        A ⊆ B)

        (∀ (j : Var), ∅ ∈ G.guards j → j = G.root) ∧

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_table_semantic_definition
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (term : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),
  (∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (winner : Role),
      winner ∈ ↑(term.eval valuation) ↔
        ∃ j, ∃ A ∈ term.table j, (∀ k ∈ A, (valuation k).Ambiguous) ∧ winner ∈ ↑(valuation j)) ∧
    ∀ (j : Var) (A : Finset Var),
      A ∈ term.table j ↔
        three 2 ∈ ↑(term.eval fun i => KFOL.Reset.chainValue three (if i = j then 2 else if i ∈ A then 1 else 0)) ∧
          ∀ B ⊆ A,
            three 2 ∈ ↑(term.eval fun i => KFOL.Reset.chainValue three (if i = j then 2 else if i ∈ B then 1 else 0)) →
              A ⊆ B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.reset_table_size
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Var : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq Var] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var),
  (∀ (j : Var), (t.table j).card ≤ (t.guards j).card ∧ (t.guards j).card ≤ t.occurrences j) ∧
    (∀ j ∉ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t, t.table j = ∅) ∧
      ∑ j ∈ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t, (t.guards j).card ≤ t.leafCount ∧
        ∑ j ∈ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t, (t.table j).card ≤ t.leafCount ∧
          1 + (List.map (fun p => p.2.card + 1) t.guardEntries).sum ≤ 1 + t.leafCount ^ 2 ∧
            1 + ∑ j ∈ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t, ∑ A ∈ t.table j, (A.card + 1) ≤
                1 + (FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t).card * t.leafCount ∧
              1 + ∑ j ∈ FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t, ∑ A ∈ t.table j, (A.card + 1) ≤ 1 + t.leafCount ^ 2 ∧
                (FirstOrder.Language.Term.varFinset t).card ≤ t.leafCount

project_declarations.type:

  ((∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation) ↔ s.table = t.table) ∧
    ((∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation) ↔
        ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          (∀ (i : Var), ∃ k, valuation i = KFOL.Reset.chainValue three k) → s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation) ∧
      (∀ {Role' : Type w} (_three' : Fin 3 ↪ Role'),
          (∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation) ↔
            ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role'), s.eval valuation = t.eval valuation) ∧
        ∀ (i j : Fin 3),
          (KFOL.Reset.chainValue three i).reset (KFOL.Reset.chainValue three j) =
            KFOL.Reset.chainValue three (if j = 0 then 0 else max i j)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.round_equilibrium_recursion
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role]
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
  (∀ (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role), game.sequentialValues order = game.observedValues) ∧
    (∀ (r : Role), (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf r).sequentialValues order = {PMF.pure r}) ∧
      ∀ (sizes : Role → ℕ) (next : ((i : Role) → Fin (sizes i + 1)) → KFOL.Rounds.Game Role) (value : PMF Role),
        value ∈ (KFOL.Rounds.Game.round sizes next).sequentialValues order ↔
          ∃ p,
            (∀ (a : (i : Role) → Fin (sizes i + 1)), p a ∈ (next a).sequentialValues order) ∧
              ∃ root,
                GameTheory.IsNash (KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm sizes p).mixed
                    (GameTheory.euPreference fun winner i => KFOL.Rounds.Game.winnerPayoff id i winner) root ∧
                  value = (KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm sizes p).mixed.play root

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Finite Role] (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role)
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role)

  assessment.IsSequentiallyConsistent ⋯ →
    ∀ (h : game.execution.History) (ht : ¬game.execution.terminal h.state) (i : Role),
      assessment.belief i (game.serialSite order h ht i) = game.productBelief order assessment.strategy h ht i

project_declarations.type:

  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role)
  (strategy : (i : Role) → (game.serialized order).information.BehavioralPolicy i),
  ∃ assessment,
    assessment.strategy = strategy ∧
      assessment.IsSequentiallyConsistent ⋯ ∧
        ∀ (h : game.execution.History) (ht : ¬game.execution.terminal h.state) (i : Role),
          assessment.belief i (game.serialSite order h ht i) = game.productBelief order strategy h ht i

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (game : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role)
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),

          (∀ (p : game.Position), game.execution.Reachable p) ∧
            (∀ (h : game.execution.History), game.information.IsSubgameRoot h) ∧
              (∃ bound, 0 < bound ∧ game.execution.BoundedHorizon bound) ∧
                (∃ bound, 0 < bound ∧ (game.serialized order).execution.BoundedHorizon bound) ∧
                  ∀ (payoff : Role → (game.serialized order).execution.History → ℝ),
