project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.scalar_contextual_equivalence
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (left right : KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm)
          (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
          (left.rate = right.rate ↔
              ∀ (context : KFOL.Rounds.Game.Context Role),
                KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                    ((context.fill (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b left)).sequentialValues order) =
                  KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                    ((context.fill (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b right)).sequentialValues order)) ∧
            (left.rate = right.rate ↔
              ∀ (context : KFOL.Rounds.Game.Context Role),
                c ∈
                    KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                      ((context.fill (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b left)).sequentialValues order) ↔
                  c ∈
                    KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                      ((context.fill (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b right)).sequentialValues order))

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.scalar_diagonal_security
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1),
      0 < x + y →
        ∃ row col,
          (row 0).toReal = y / (x + y) ∧
            (col 0).toReal = y / (x + y) ∧
              ∀ (profile : (i : Role) → PMF (Fin (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b i + 1))),
                (((KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b)
                                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.diagonalTable a b
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1)
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1))).mixed.play
                          (GameTheory.Profile.update profile a row))
                        a).toReal =
                    x * y / (x + y) ∧
                  (((KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b)
                                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.diagonalTable a b
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1)
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1))).mixed.play
                          (GameTheory.Profile.update profile b col))
                        a).toReal =
                    x * y / (x + y)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.scalar_diagonal_values
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (left right : KFOL.Rounds.Game Role) (x y : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1)
      (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
      left.sequentialValues order = {GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix x hx0 hx1 (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure b)} →
        right.sequentialValues order = {GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix y hy0 hy1 (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure b)} →
          (KFOL.Rounds.Game.diagonal a b left right).sequentialValues order =
            {GameTheory.Math.Probability.mix (x * y / (x + y)) ⋯ ⋯ (PMF.pure a) (PMF.pure b)}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.scalar_rational_values
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role),
      (∀ (term : KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm),
          (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b term).sequentialValues order =
            {KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b ↑term.rate ⋯ ⋯}) ∧
        {q | ∃ term, term.UnaryGenerated ∧ term.rate = q} = Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
          ∀ (q : ℚ) (h0 : 0 ≤ q) (h1 : q ≤ 1),
            ∃ term,
              term.UnaryGenerated ∧
                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.ScalarTerm.game a b term).sequentialValues order =
                  {KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b ↑q ⋯ ⋯}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.semilattice_trace
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
      (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
        t.vars.Nonempty ∧
          ∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            (∀ (x : Fin n), (valuation x).Ambiguous) →
              ∀ (r : Role), r ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) ↔ ∃ x ∈ t.vars, r ∈ ↑(valuation x)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (s t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
        (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) s = A) →
          (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
            ((∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                (∀ (x : Fin n), (valuation x).Ambiguous) → KFOL.Term.eval valuation s = KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) ↔
              s.vars = t.vars)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin n)),
          S.Nonempty → ∃ t, t.IsCore ∧ t.vars = S ∧ ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n),
            (KFOL.Term.var i).vars = {i} ∧
              ∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval valuation (KFOL.Term.var i) = valuation i) ∧
          (∀ (m n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin m)) (replacement : Fin m → KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
              (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) →
                (∀ (x : Fin m) (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) (replacement x) = A) →
                  (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) (KFOL.Term.subst replacement t) = A) ∧
                    ((KFOL.Term.subst replacement t).vars = t.vars.biUnion fun x => (replacement x).vars) ∧
                      ∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                        KFOL.Term.eval valuation (KFOL.Term.subst replacement t) =
                          KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => KFOL.Term.eval valuation (replacement x)) t) ∧
            (∀ (n : ℕ),
                0 < n →
                  ∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
                    ¬∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (i : Fin n),
                        KFOL.Term.eval (Function.update (fun x => A) i B) t = A) ∧
              (∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin 3)),
                  ¬((∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => if i = 0 then A else B) t = A) ∧
                      ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => if i = 2 then B else A) t = B)) ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
                    t.IsCore →
                      ∀ x ∈ t.vars,
                        ∃ v w, (∀ (y : Fin n), y ≠ x → v y = w y) ∧ KFOL.Term.eval v t ≠ KFOL.Term.eval w t) ∧
                  ∀ (n : ℕ) (s t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
                    s.IsCore →
                      t.IsCore →
                        (∀ (valuation : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                            KFOL.Term.eval valuation s = KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) →
                          s.vars = t.vars

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.status_cell_provenance
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var) (base : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  ∃ C P,
    C.Finite ∧
      (∀ (j : Var), ∀ p ∈ P j, (base j).Ambiguous) ∧
        ∀ (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          (∀ (j : Var) (r : Role), base j = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r ↔ valuation j = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) →
            ↑(KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) = C ∪ ⋃ j, ⋃ p ∈ P j, ⇑p '' ↑(valuation j)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.switching_observation
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (k : Role) (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (t : KFOL.Term Role (Option (Fin n))) (parameters : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
      k ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => x.elim A parameters) t) ↔ k ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => x.elim B parameters) t)) ↔
    A = B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.symmetric_congruence_chain
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] [inst : Nonempty Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.SymmetricCongruence Role),
      ∃! m,
        ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) B) ∧
    (∀ (m : Fin (Nat.card Role)),
        ∃ θ,
          ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) B) ∧
      Nat.card (KFOL.WinnerSet.SymmetricCongruence Role) = Nat.card Role ∧
        (∀ (m n : ℕ),
            m ≤ n →
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold n A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold n B →
                  KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m B) ∧
          (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold 0 A = KFOL.WinnerSet.full) ∧
            (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (Nat.card Role - 1) A = A) ∧
              ∀ m < Nat.card Role,
                Nat.card (Quotient (Setoid.ker (KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m))) =
                  1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, (Nat.card Role).choose j

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.two_player_degeneracies
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (labels : Fin 2 ≃ Role),
  (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), A.reset B = B) ∧
    (∀ (r : Role) (X Y Z : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice r X Y Z = X) ∧
      (∀ (D : Set Role) (X Y Z : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.WinnerSet.policyReset D X Y Z = X) ∧
        (∀ (Var : Type v) (t : KFOL.Term Role Var) (x : Var → Role),
            ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (x i)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
          (∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role Empty), ∃ r, KFOL.Term.eval Empty.elim t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r) ∧
            (¬∃ t, ∀ (x : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval x t = (x 0).union (x 1)) ∧
              ∃ t,
                (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => A) t = A) ∧
                  ¬∃ s, s.IsCore ∧ ∀ (x : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval x s = KFOL.Term.eval x t

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (labels : Fin 2 ≃ Role),
  have x := KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.winnerStructure labels;
  Set.Finite KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.basis ∧
    (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.Symbol),
        e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) ↔ KFOL.Equational.Derives KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.basis e.lhs e.rhs) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (s t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin n)),
        (∀ (x : Fin n → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval x s = KFOL.Term.eval x t) ↔
          KFOL.Equational.Derives KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.basis (KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.ofPublic labels s)
            (KFOL.TwoPlayers.Kleene.ofPublic labels t)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.two_player_forcing_coordinates
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (labels : Fin 2 ≃ Role),
  Function.Injective (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels) ∧
    (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 0) A B) =
          ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1 || (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).1,
            (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2 && (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).2)) ∧
      (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 1) A B) =
            ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1 && (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).1,
              (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2 || (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).2)) ∧
        (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.rename (Equiv.swap (labels 0) (labels 1)) A) =
              ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2, (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1)) ∧
          ∀ (p : Bool × Bool), (∃ A, KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A = p) ↔ ¬(p.1 = true ∧ p.2 = true)

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (labels : Fin 2 ≃ Role),

        (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), q (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 1) A B) = min (q A) (q B)) ∧
          ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), q (KFOL.WinnerSet.rename (Equiv.swap (labels 0) (labels 1)) A) = (q A).rev

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.two_player_round_contexts
project_declarations.type:
∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder (Fin 2)),
  (∀ (left right : KFOL.Rounds.Game (Fin 2)),
      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners (left.sequentialValues order) =
          KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners (right.sequentialValues order) →
        ∀ (context : KFOL.Rounds.Game.Context (Fin 2)),
          KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((context.fill left).sequentialValues order) =
            KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((context.fill right).sequentialValues order)) ∧
    KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.diagonal 0 1 (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf 0) (KFOL.Rounds.Game.leaf 0)).sequentialValues order) =
      {0, 1}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.two_player_round_support
project_declarations.type:
∀ (sizes : Fin 2 → ℕ) (next : ((i : Fin 2) → Fin (sizes i + 1)) → KFOL.Rounds.Game (Fin 2))
  (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder (Fin 2)),
  ∃ g,
    (∀ (actions : (i : Fin 2) → Fin (sizes i + 1)),
        ↑(g actions) = KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((next actions).sequentialValues order)) ∧
      have Sa :=
        KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold 0 Finset.univ ⋯ fun row =>
          KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold 1 Finset.univ ⋯ fun col =>
            g (KFOL.Rounds.Game.TwoPlayers.matrixAction sizes row col);
      have Sb :=
        KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold 1 Finset.univ ⋯ fun col =>
          KFOL.WinnerSet.choiceFold 0 Finset.univ ⋯ fun row =>
            g (KFOL.Rounds.Game.TwoPlayers.matrixAction sizes row col);
      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.round sizes next).sequentialValues order) = ↑(Sa.union Sb) ∧
        Sa.union Sb =
          KFOL.WinnerSet.choice 1
            (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice 0 Sa ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton 0).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton 1))) Sb

          ∀ (X : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), ↑X ⊆ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => X) s)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.uniform_core_extraction_runtime
project_declarations.type:
Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime KFOL.FullTermCode.extractWord Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
    (Turing.MultiTapeTM.encOption Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits) ∧
  ∀ (K : ℕ) (term : KFOL.Term (Fin K) ℕ),
    KFOL.FullTermCode.extractWord (KFOL.FullTermCode.encodeInput ⟨K, term⟩) =
      Option.map (fun core => KFOL.FullTermCode.encodeInput ⟨K, core⟩) (KFOL.Term.extractCore? 1 term)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.uniform_equational_complexity
project_declarations.type:
Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
    {word |
      ∃ input,
        3 ≤ input.fst ∧
          KFOL.FullTermCode.encodeEquationInput input = word ∧
            ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin input.fst)),
              KFOL.Term.eval valuation input.snd.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation input.snd.2} ∧
  Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
      {word |
        ∃ input,
          3 ≤ input.fst ∧
            KFOL.FullTermCode.encodeEquationInput input = word ∧
              input.snd.1.IsPublic ∧
                input.snd.2.IsPublic ∧
                  ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin input.fst)),
                    KFOL.Term.eval valuation input.snd.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation input.snd.2} ∧
    Cslib.Complexity.coNPComplete Turing.MultiTapeTM.encBits
      {word |
        ∃ input,
          3 ≤ input.fst ∧
            KFOL.FullTermCode.encodeEquationInput input = word ∧
              input.snd.1.IsCore ∧
                input.snd.2.IsCore ∧
                  ∀ (valuation : ℕ → KFOL.WinnerSet (Fin input.fst)),
                    KFOL.Term.eval valuation input.snd.1 = KFOL.Term.eval valuation input.snd.2}

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.uniform_matroid_identification
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] [inst : Nonempty Role],
  ∀ m < Nat.card Role,
    ∃ M,
      M.E = Set.univ ∧
        (∀ (I : Set Role), M.Indep I ↔ I.ncard ≤ m + 1) ∧
          M.eRank = ↑(m + 1) ∧ ∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m A) = M.closure ↑A

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.unique_winner_observations
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  t.IsPublic →
    ∀ (active : Var → Bool) (parameters : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
      ((∃ C, ∀ (X : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => if active x = true then X else parameters x) t = C) ∨
          ∀ (X : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            ↑X ⊆ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => if active x = true then X else parameters x) t)) ∧
        ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          A.Ambiguous →
            B.Ambiguous →
              ∀ (r : Role),
                KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => if active x = true then A else parameters x) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r ↔
                  KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => if active x = true then B else parameters x) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton r
